column1: # tests/coverage/unreachable.tsv - the markers of libhttpasm.so the tests do not run, each
# with its reason (tests/coverage/report.cs: the gate fails on a marker that did not run and is
# not listed here, and on an entry whose markers ran; docs/DESIGN.md section 2). One line per
# marker, tab-separated: file, kind (block, taken, fall), scope (the label scope: the function,
# usually), text (the labels or the jump; NASM's macro-local numbers as "..@."), reason. A
#   unreachable:  a proof that nothing reaches it, from the code (each caller's checks, an
#   rare:         reachable, under conditions no test provokes yet, named;
#   race:         taken only by a race (between threads, or the worker and the kernel's
#                 completions): exempt from going stale, it may run in any one run;
#   kernel:       reached on some kernels and not others (the gate runs on WSL's 5.15 and on
# Markers alike in key (two "jz .out" of one function) are a multiset: one line each, and all
# of a key's lines exempt or none. Started from report.cs --write-unreachable's draft.

column5: reason

unreachable: it skips extended leaf 0x80000001 when the highest extended leaf is below it, which no x86-64 CPU reports: that leaf carries the long-mode bit this 64-bit code runs under (Intel SDE refuses a CPU table without it)

unreachable: gcm_crypt_vaes calls it only with a count above 0: the AAD's last octets after jz .aad_done has skipped aad_length & 15 = 0, and the tail's copies after jz .lengths has skipped no octets left; the guard stays because the routine takes any count, as ha_copy_short does

unreachable: every caller passes at least one block: httpasm_sha256_update compresses its filled buffer (1) and its whole blocks only after jz .tail has skipped a count of 0, httpasm_sha256_final passes 1 or 2; the guard stays because both versions are do-while loops that would compress a block past the data for 0

unreachable: every caller passes at least one block: httpasm_sha512_update compresses its filled buffer (1) and its whole blocks only after jz .tail has skipped a count of 0, sha512_finish passes 1 or 2; the guard stays because v1 is a do-while loop and v3 runs a pair before its first test, both of which would compress a block past the data for 0

unreachable: .one_pass_reason_edge is entered with an octet before B: the reason's steps start at offset 13 with B >= 15 (.one_pass bails below 15), and a step advances by 16 only from at most B - 17 (.one_pass_reason's compare), so the step that reaches the edge starts at most at B - 1; the guard stays because a step at B could start on an unmapped page
